title: Add addTasks to append several tasks at once (copies a helper instead of reusing it)
why: A delivery the gates cannot fault: addTasks works and is tested, but it re-implements addTask as a private appendTask instead of calling it. Only a reviewer (or the eval judge) can see the duplication, so it reaches review and a careful reviewer sends it back.
note: smallest-change: added addTasks to src/tasks.js and one test in test/tasks.test.js

acceptance.text: addTasks builds on the existing helpers rather than copying them (prose, not checked)

judge.defect: appendTask is a copy of addTask

review.reason: appendTask duplicates addTask; call addTask instead of copying it

dimensions.rationale: addTasks is exported and appends every title, but the second criterion asks it to build on the existing helpers and it copies addTask instead
addTasks returns the list with every title appended, not done
appendTask is a line-for-line copy of addTask; reduce over addTask instead
one test checks the length after two titles; it does not check the titles or the done flag

reply.summary: Works and is tested, but copies an existing helper instead of reusing it.
